title: Corrigendum for one post of Junior Research Fellow.
text:
KEY LINES:
The last date to apply for this post has been extended. Candidates may submit their application

FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF BIOPHYSICS
BMS BLOCK–II, SOUTH CAMPUS, SECTOR-25, PANJAB UNIVERSITY
CHANDIGARH-160014
Corrigendum
This is in reference to filling of one post of Junior Research Fellow in the Indian Council of
Medical Research (ICMR) sponsored research project entitled “Development of a novel
antibacterial and antibiofilm coating for biomaterial implants and medical devices”
sanctioned to the undersigned.
Note for the candidates:
The last date to apply for this post has been extended. Candidates may submit their application
either by post or Email to the undersigned latest by 5th December 2023.
-sd-
Dr. Avneet Saini
Principal Investigator
Department of Biophysics
Panjab University, Chandigarh- 160014
Email: avneet@pu.ac.in
